blocks.text: Jpark Island Resort & Waterpark Cebu welcomed 56 learners from Marigondon Elementary School’s Special Needs Education (SNED) program in Lapu-Lapu City on November 9, 2026, for a day of recreation and shared experiences under its 2026 Adapt-a-School Program. Accompanied by their parents, guardians, and teachers, the children enjoyed the resort’s attractions and activities, giving them opportunities to explore new experiences, interact with other children, and spend meaningful time with their families. For the learners, the visit provided a chance to participate in recreational activities outside their usual routine, highlighting the importance of making leisure experiences more accessible and inclusive for children […]...
